title: Texas TABC restaurant and bar liquor-license-holder review
hypothesis: An active TABC person-form owner field is liquor-license-holder evidence only. It does not prove that person operates the restaurant, is its permit manager, owns its operating business, owns a handset, or has a direct business contact. With no TABC phone field, the current safe route holds the row unless a separately implemented public business contact is explicitly tied to the exact business.
ownerSource: TABC 7hf9-qc9f provides an active alcohol-license owner field and trade/premises details. A parseable person is a liquor-license-holder candidate, not a restaurant operator, permit manager, current business owner, or owner-confirmed contact. Entity, institutional, and incomplete-person rows are held.
phoneSource: The implemented TABC fixture and catalog audit show no phone field. A TABC mailing or premises address is not a contact source and may not be used for parcel, residential, append, or trace work. The only future contact source is an explicitly published business contact from a separately implemented eligible public source, matched to the exact trade name and premises.

workflow.label: Active TABC liquor-license record
workflow.detail: Read the implemented active BG, BQ, NT, and MB register segments with license, trade name, holder field, and premises provenance. This is alcohol-license evidence, not restaurant-operation evidence.

workflow.label: Person-form license holder?
workflow.detail: Require a current active supported record and a parseable person-form holder. Entity, institution, incomplete-name, and unsupported-type rows cannot enter a person branch.

workflow.label: Hold entity or incomplete holder
workflow.detail: Hold entity, university, nonprofit, corporate, initial-only, missing-holder, inactive, and unsupported-license rows. Do not resolve officers or infer a person.

workflow.label: Classify liquor-license-holder evidence
workflow.detail: Retain a person-form TABC holder only as a liquor-license-holder candidate. Do not label the person Owner, restaurant Operator, Permit manager, or direct contact from this record.

workflow.label: Current restaurant-operation evidence?
workflow.detail: Require independent current evidence that the exact trade name and premises operate an in-scope restaurant or bar. Liquor type, DBA, license holder, or premise alone does not establish operating role.

workflow.label: Hold non-restaurant or role-ambiguous record
workflow.detail: Hold off-premise, nonprofit, university, catering, institutional, chain, closed, mismatched-premises, and holder-only records; a license holder or permit manager is not automatically the restaurant operator.

workflow.label: Explicit published business contact available?
workflow.detail: Only a separately implemented, legally eligible public business contact explicitly matched to the exact trade name and premises may proceed. TABC has no phone field; its addresses cannot substitute.

workflow.label: Hold without published business contact
workflow.detail: Hold the TABC provenance when no eligible published business contact is available or when the contact is shared, stale, mismatched, or not explicitly tied to the business. Never parcel-search, append, trace, or use a residential mailing address.

workflow.label: Business-contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: For a future explicit business contact, require line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks. A mobile result does not establish the holder's or operator's handset.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact gate
workflow.detail: Hold landline, VoIP, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, shared-office, or timezone-unresolved business contacts.

workflow.label: Owner/operator and direct-contact proof
workflow.detail: Require independent current support that the matched person owns or operates the restaurant and explicit evidence that this same published business contact is direct to that supported role. License-holder, permit-manager, name, or number match alone fails.

workflow.label: Hold unresolved owner contact
workflow.detail: Hold liquor-license-holder-only, permit-manager-only, entity, employee, chain, conflicting-role, shared-office, and unlinked-contact cases; do not infer handset ownership.

workflow.label: Future supported restaurant owner contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only after restaurant-operation, public business-contact, compliance, independent owner/operator, and direct-contact evidence all pass.

edges.label: entity, institution, incomplete holder, inactive, or unsupported type
restaurant operation or role evidence absent, mismatched, or excluded
no explicit linked published business contact
owner/operator or direct-contact evidence missing or conflicting

failures.risk: The TABC owner field is represented as a restaurant owner, operator, permit manager, or owner-confirmed mobile.
failures.mitigation: Rename the parser role to liquor-license-holder candidate and require independent current restaurant-operation, owner/operator, and direct-business-contact evidence.

failures.risk: A TABC mailing address that differs from the premises is treated as a home address and routed through parcel or paid trace.
failures.mitigation: For restaurant_tx, hold before parcel and trace; never derive or retain a residential address, append a private phone, or invoke a paid trace from TABC address fields.

failures.risk: BQ/off-premise, NT/nonprofit, university, catering, chain, or entity-held alcohol licenses are treated as independent restaurant-operator leads.
failures.mitigation: Require separate current restaurant-operation evidence for exact trade name and premises, then hold all role-ambiguous or excluded cohorts.

failures.risk: A public business number is relabelled as the liquor holder's or operator's direct handset.
failures.mitigation: Use an explicit published business contact only as a business-contact candidate; require line/compliance gates and a separate direct business-role link.

failures.risk: The generic recipe-B quote permits residential fallback because a different TABC mailing address exists.
failures.mitigation: Special-case restaurant_tx in quote and advance paths so an explicit implemented public business-contact source is the only fallback; otherwise hold with published_business_contact_unavailable.

sources.scope: A legally eligible public business contact explicitly tied to the exact trade name and premises. No such restaurant_tx source or owner/operator/direct-contact gate is implemented in the catalog/runtime audit.

iterations.hypothesis: The TABC parser keeps person-form license holders and holds entity holders, while a different mailing address can enter the recipe-B residential path even though no phone exists.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24 over the first five saved rows in tests/fixtures/registers/tx_tabc.json through txTabc and the focused tx_tabc register test. No network, secret, paid provider, append, trace, residential/property lookup, or contact-data export ran.
iterations.observed: 3/5 person-form holder values were retained and 2/5 entity-holder values were held as owner_is_entity. Of the retained rows, 1/3 had mailDiffersFromPremises=true and was assigned the differing mailing street; 2/3 had matching mailing/premises addresses and no street. The five rows contained no phone field. The parser labels every retained person titleCode Owner, while the source/fixture does not establish restaurant operation, permit-manager role, or contact ownership.
iterations.change: Make liquor-license-holder status explicit, hold restaurant_tx before any residential phase, and require an implemented explicit published-business-contact source plus independent role and direct-contact evidence for every future delivery.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: The TABC adapter now labels the person License Holder rather than Owner. That does not establish restaurant ownership or a direct handset; a separately published business-contact route is still pending.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five saved TABC fixtures: 3 person-form holder rows retained; 2 entity-holder rows held as owner_is_entity; 1 of the 3 retained rows had a mailing address different from premises and was assigned that address by the parser; 0/5 exposed a phone field. Fixture/code audit only; no live source, restaurant-operation, owner/operator, permit-manager, handset, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-row fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, residential lookup, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner or operator contact was measured. Historical brain estimates use another denominator and do not establish a restaurant business-contact or owner-contact cost.

implementation.summary: The TABC adapter now labels the person License Holder rather than Owner. That does not establish restaurant ownership or a direct handset; a separately published business-contact route is still pending. Original review: TABC active-record filtering, person parsing, entity holds, and source provenance are implemented. The parser overstates a liquor-license holder as Owner and the generic recipe-B flow can route a differing TABC mailing address into residential parcel and paid trace. No explicit published-business-contact fallback or independent restaurant-operator/direct-contact proof is implemented.

nextMeasurement: After restaurant_tx is held before parcel/trace and a catalog-verified public business-contact source is implemented, run only a lawful 5–20-row aggregate study. Separate active alcohol licenses, person-form license holders, restaurant-operation support, license-holder/operator/permit-manager roles, explicit business contacts, independent owner/operator support, direct-contact support, mobile, reachable, DNC/TCPA-clear, suppression/duplicate-clear, and delivered. Do not use residential, property, private-phone, paid, secret, or prohibited-list sources.
